northbank/month-semantics: Northbank month semantics: trial-a5s permanently changes active reconcile and refunds_csv for every requested month, including past years, to [first calendar date 05:00:00 UTC, next month first calendar date 05:00:00 UTC). The cutoff is fixed year-round with no daylight saving adjustment. Both operations share cli.month_window through month_transactions; timestamps are compared as absolute instants, ordered by posting instant then lexicographic ID. Response shapes, transaction overrides, CSV original timestamps/escaping, and positive refund magnitudes remain unchanged. incident_replay for INC-204 stays frozen on complete UTC calendar months [00:00 UTC first day, 00:00 UTC next first day), with independent logic in incident_replay.py. Bundled 2025-02 active net is 23800 cents with p-mar-open after p-offset-feb; replay net remains 14800 cents. Evidence: trial-a5s, README.md, cli.py, incident_replay.py; verified with 15 unittest tests and all six public_tests/stage_4.json cases.
